headline: Malware Sparks Operational Meltdown at Stanley Electric's U.S. Facilities
body: A severe malware invasion has crippled operations at SE's U.S. sites, resulting in an abrupt production halt. Crucial manufacturing systems were infected, forcing Stanley to cease operations and commence a meticulous restoration of affected networks. The company anticipates a phased reboot of its assembly lines, although no external ransom demands have been disclosed. With supply chains already strained, the shutdown at Stanley's Ohio and Michigan plants could ripple through the automotive sector.
